name: Opalescence
role: Colorshift>UW; animation engine, half of Opalescence+Humility lock
text: Each other non-Aura enchantment is a creature in addition to its other types and has base power and base toughness each equal to its mana value.
note: Locked colorshift>UW. With Humility every creature 0/0 = board lock

name: Humility
role: Mass ability/stat shutoff; Opalescence partner = 0/0 lock
text: All creatures lose all abilities and have base power and toughness 1/1.
note: Tempest. Layer interaction w/ Opalescence wipes board; classic UW lock

name: Enchanted Evening
role: Turns all permanents into enchantments; enables Opalescence/Replenish sweep
errata_proposal: ETB: mill top 3, then return an enchantment card from your graveyard to hand (per spec #10).
text: All permanents are enchantments in addition to their other types.
note: Errata'd ETB mill3+return enchantment. Opalescence = symmetric Armageddon

name: Replenish
role: Honest combo payoff: dump enchantments to GY, then mass-reanimate them
text: Return all enchantment cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
note: Stapled-to-spell payoff (#16-legal). Needs GY-fill; one-shot, fragile

name: Starfield of Nyx
role: Slow Replenish-on-a-stick + Opalescence-style animation at 5 enchantments
text:
At the beginning of your upkeep, you may return target enchantment card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
As long as you control five or more enchantments, each other non-Aura enchantment you control is a creature in addition to its other types and has base power and base toughness each equal to its mana value.
note: Fragile top-end (needs heavy enchant count). Watch repeated-value; gated

name: Sigil of the Empty Throne
role: Enchantress payoff: enchantment spells make 4/4 fliers
text: Whenever you cast an enchantment spell, create a 4/4 white Angel creature token with flying.
note: Top-end wincon for enchantress shell; slow, needs density

name: Mesa Enchantress
role: The enchantress card-draw engine; no in-block equivalent exists
text: Whenever you cast an enchantment spell, you may draw a card.
note: Out-exc: archetype draw-engine, zero ODY/ONS enchantress prints. Weak 0/2 body

name: Open the Vaults
role: Symmetric Replenish variant; also returns artifacts (lantern/lock synergy)
text: Return all artifact and enchantment cards from all graveyards to the battlefield under their owners' control. (Auras with nothing to enchant remain in graveyards.)
note: Symmetric (downside) Replenish; bridges to lantern/artifact lock pieces

name: Parallax Wave
role: Fading/depletion-counter removal; the missed fading theme
text:
Fading 5 (This enchantment enters with five fade counters on it. At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a fade counter from it. If you can't, sacrifice it.)
Remove a fade counter from this enchantment: Exile target creature.
When this enchantment leaves the battlefield, each player returns to the battlefield all cards they own exiled with it.
note: Fading depletion theme. Blink w/ Replenish = permanent exile combo; high Elo

name: Parallax Tide
role: Fading land-denial; depletion-counter prison piece
text:
Fading 5 (This enchantment enters with five fade counters on it. At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a fade counter from it. If you can't, sacrifice it.)
Remove a fade counter from this enchantment: Exile target land.
When this enchantment leaves the battlefield, each player returns to the battlefield all cards they own exiled with it.
note: Fading land lock. Re-Replenish before LTB trigger = soft Armageddon

name: Seal of Cleansing
role: Pre-placed artifact/enchant removal; enchantment-typed Replenish fodder
text: Sacrifice this enchantment: Destroy target artifact or enchantment.
note: Enchantress trigger + recurs via Replenish for repeated Disenchant

name: Seal of Removal
role: Pre-placed bounce; cheap blue enchantment for enchantress/Replenish
text: Sacrifice this enchantment: Return target creature to its owner's hand.
note: 1-mana blue enchantment; enchantress fuel, recurring tempo via Replenish

name: Aura of Silence
role: Artifact/enchant tax + sac removal; recurring via Replenish
text:
Artifact and enchantment spells your opponents cast cost {2} more to cast.
Sacrifice this enchantment: Destroy target artifact or enchantment.
note: Hate-piece vs Smokestack/Bridge mirror; Replenish loop = repeat Disenchant

name: Sterling Grove
role: Enchantment toolbox tutor + shroud protection for the shell
text:
Other enchantments you control have shroud. (They can't be the targets of spells or abilities.)
{1}, Sacrifice this enchantment: Search your library for an enchantment card, reveal it, then shuffle and put that card on top.
note: GW gold (counts toward Selesnya). Protects lock; tutors Opalescence/Humility

name: Hall of Heliod's Generosity
role: Repeatable enchantment recursion from GY (mana-light Replenish trickle)
text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{1}{W}, {T}: Put target enchantment card from your graveyard on top of your library.
note: Land slot; grindy single-enchant recursion. Belongs in Land section, not WU

name: Enlightened Tutor
role: Instant toolbox tutor for the lock piece / hate enchantment
text: Search your library for an artifact or enchantment card, reveal it, then shuffle and put that card on top.
note: Low-power-friendly (card disadvantage, top-of-deck). Consistency for combo

name: Idyllic Tutor
role: Enchantment tutor straight to hand; finds Opalescence/Humility/lock
text: Search your library for an enchantment card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
note: Slower than Enlightened but to-hand; redundant tutor (singleton OK, surplus)

name: Greater Auramancy
role: Shroud protection for whole enchantment lock shell
text:
Other enchantments you control have shroud. (A permanent with shroud can't be the target of spells or abilities.)
Enchanted creatures you control have shroud.
note: Protects Opalescence/Humility lock from removal; redundant w/ Sterling Grove

name: Karmic Justice
role: Deterrent protection: punishes destruction of your noncreature permanents
text: Whenever a spell or ability an opponent controls destroys a noncreature permanent you control, you may destroy target permanent that opponent controls.
note: In-block (ODY). Taxes opponents for breaking your enchantment lock

name: Solitary Confinement
role: Near-hexproof fog-lock; pairs with enchantress/discard-engine card flow
text:
At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice this enchantment unless you discard a card.
Skip your draw step.
You have shroud.
Prevent all damage that would be dealt to you.
note: In-block (JUD). Hard lock vs aggro; needs card-engine to feed discard

name: Earnest Fellowship
role: Quasi-Humility: protection-from-own-colors disrupts combat & auras
text: Each creature has protection from its colors.
note: In-block (ODY). Symmetric combat fog/aura-hoser; weird build-around

name: Propaganda
role: Blue pillowfort tax; buys time for lock/combo assembly
text: Creatures can't attack you unless their controller pays {2} for each creature they control that's attacking you.
note: Blue Ghostly Prison; enchantress fuel. Redundant w/ Ghostly Prison (singleton)

name: Ghostly Prison
role: White pillowfort tax; core defensive enchantress piece
text: Creatures can't attack you unless their controller pays {2} for each creature they control that's attacking you.
note: White Propaganda; weak creatures make tax bite. Pick one of the pair

name: Sphere of Safety
role: Scaling pillowfort payoff that rewards enchantment density
printings: RTR, C16, DSC, PIO, RVR, SLD
text: Creatures can't attack you or planeswalkers you control unless their controller pays {X} for each of those creatures, where X is the number of enchantments you control.
note: Enchantress payoff; tax scales w/ shell. Soft-locks combat at density

name: Teferi's Moat
role: Color-locked ground stax; on-color gold pillowfort
text:
As this enchantment enters, choose a color.
Creatures of the chosen color without flying can't attack you.
note: WU gold pillowfort; shuts a color out of combat. Counts toward Azorius

name: Dovescape
role: Noncreature-spell soft-lock making symmetric 1/1 bird wall
text:
({W/U} can be paid with either {W} or {U}.)
Whenever a player casts a noncreature spell, counter that spell. That player creates X 1/1 white and blue Bird creature tokens with flying, where X is the spell's mana value.
note: WU gold; ties into Birds tribal. Symmetric lock — wild build-around

name: Story Circle
role: Color-based damage prevention lock vs mono-color decks
text:
As this enchantment enters, choose a color.
{W}: The next time a source of your choice of the chosen color would deal damage to you this turn, prevent that damage.
note: Hard damage lock vs a color; decision-intensive mana sink

name: Suppression Field
role: Activated-ability tax; hoses Smokestack/lantern/sac engines
text: Activated abilities cost {2} more to activate unless they're mana abilities.
note: Symmetric stax; taxes the cube's many activated-ability engines

name: Rule of Law
role: One-spell-per-turn lock; slows storm/combo opponents
text: Each player can't cast more than one spell each turn.
note: Anti-storm lock; functional twin of Arcane Laboratory (pick one)

name: Arcane Laboratory
role: Blue one-spell-per-turn lock
text: Each player can't cast more than one spell each turn.
note: Blue Rule of Law; redundant — keep whichever color fits final balance

name: Web of Inertia
role: GY-taxing pillowfort; in-block blue defensive enchantment
text: At the beginning of combat on each opponent's turn, that player may exile a card from their graveyard. If the player doesn't, creatures they control can't attack you this turn.
note: In-block (JUD). Pillowfort that taxes GY; synergy vs Replenish/flashback foes

name: Collective Restraint
role: Domain-scaling blue pillowfort tax
text: Domain — Creatures can't attack you unless their controller pays {X} for each creature they control that's attacking you, where X is the number of basic land types among lands you control.
note: Blue Propaganda that scales w/ land types; rewards multicolor manabase

name: Standstill
role: Card-advantage trap for control/lock decks sitting behind permanents
text: When a player casts a spell, sacrifice this enchantment. If you do, each of that player's opponents draws three cards.
note: In-block (ODY). Rewards passive lock shells; cornerstone control draw

name: Compulsion
role: Looter that fills GY for Replenish; also sac-draw
text:
{1}{U}, Discard a card: Draw a card.
{1}{U}, Sacrifice this enchantment: Draw a card.
note: In-block (TOR). Discards enchantments into GY for Replenish; itself recurs

name: Attunement
role: Premier Replenish enabler: bulk-mill enchantments to GY, self-bounces
text: Return this enchantment to its owner's hand: Draw three cards, then discard four cards.
note: Classic Replenish combo piece; bins enchantments fast, reusable

name: Hatching Plans
role: Self-binning enchantment that draws 3 when destroyed; Seal/sweeper synergy
text: When this enchantment is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, draw three cards.
note: Feeds GY for Replenish AND draws; great w/ self-Disenchant (Seal/Aura of Silence)

name: Dawn of a New Age
role: Counter-based white card-draw engine; pairs proliferate/enchantress
text:
This enchantment enters with a hope counter on it for each creature you control.
At the beginning of your end step, remove a hope counter from this enchantment. If you do, draw a card. Then if this enchantment has no hope counters on it, sacrifice it and you gain 4 life.
note: Noncreature any-era OK (LTR). Hope-counter draw; proliferate-matters payoff

name: Test of Endurance
role: Honest alt-win: 50 life; pairs lifegain/Transcendence/pillowfort
text: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you have 50 or more life, you win the game.
note: In-block (JUD) alt-win enchantment; on-theme spine. Slow, fragile

name: Battle of Wits
role: Honest alt-win: 200-card library; a deckbuilding-commitment payoff
text: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you have 200 or more cards in your library, you win the game.
note: In-block (ODY) alt-win. Singleton-cube quirk: 200-card library impossible — errata?

name: Transcendence
role: Life-inversion build-around; high-decision lifegain/loss puzzle
text:
You don't lose the game for having 0 or less life.
When you have 20 or more life, you lose the game.
Whenever you lose life, you gain 2 life for each 1 life you lost.
note: In-block (TOR). Inverted life rules; pairs Mirror Universe/life-loss themes
